influences.name: Teiko Ito

influences.name: Maya Deren
influences.context: Ito's encounter with Maya Deren brought not only artistic opportunities, but also a significant spiritual component into his life: namely voodoo. Maya was already deeply initiated to this world: she was a Voodoo priest when they met. When Teiji and Maya started living together, they began to share everything in life, including Maya's strong interest in voodoo, for which they traveled together to Haiti several times.

influences.name: Haitian drum master
influences.context: There, Teiji learned Haitian Drums from an indigenous Haitian drum master.

influences.name: Levi-Strauss
influences.context: I was also very influenced by Levi-Strauss' writings around bricolage, and I think in order to enter Teiji's spirit one does need to have the attitude of the bricoleur.
